## Purpose and Entry Point
Claudian is a desktop-only Obsidian plugin that turns the current vault into a working directory for AI coding-agent CLIs. It supplies chat, inline editing, skills/commands, session management, and experimental Git-based collaboration. Plugin bootstrap begins at `src/main.ts`; application wiring, persistence, and provider hosting sit in `src/app/providers/ClaudianProviderHost.ts` and `src/core/bootstrap/storage.ts`.

## Layering and Contracts
`src/core/` is the provider-neutral domain boundary: execution requests/events/sessions, provider registration, commands, prompts, storage, and typed contracts. `src/core/execution/ProviderExecutionBackend.ts`, `src/core/execution/ProviderExecutionSession.ts`, and `src/core/providers/ProviderRegistry.ts` let UI code operate independently of a specific agent runtime. `src/providers/` implements those contracts; `src/features/` owns Obsidian-facing screens and interaction control.

## Agent Provider Runtime
Provider modules adapt installed local CLIs/SDKs rather than hosting models directly. The supported integrations are Claude, Codex, Grok, OpenCode, and Pi, registered through `src/providers/index.ts` and provider registrations such as `src/providers/claude/registration.ts` and `src/providers/codex/registration.ts`. Runtimes use subprocesses and protocol transports—e.g., Claude execution, Codex app-server JSON-RPC, and shared ACP—at `src/providers/claude/execution/ClaudeExecutionBackend.ts`, `src/providers/codex/runtime/CodexAppServerProcess.ts`, and `src/providers/acp/AcpClientConnection.ts`. External model/API traffic is consequently controlled by the selected CLI/provider and its environment/MCP configuration.

## Chat Execution and UI
The sidebar chat composes tabs, vault context, stream rendering, and provider sessions. `src/features/chat/ClaudianView.ts` is the main view; `src/features/chat/tabs/TabManager.ts` manages concurrent conversations; `src/features/chat/execution/ChatExecutionCoordinator.ts` translates a user turn into a core execution session. Normalized provider events flow through chat controllers and renderers, notably `src/features/chat/controllers/StreamController.ts` and `src/features/chat/rendering/MessageRenderer.ts`. Auxiliary requests such as inline edits, instruction refinement, and title generation reuse core services under `src/core/auxiliary/`.

## Persistence, Vault, and Settings Boundaries
Obsidian vault files are the agent workspace and are accessed through storage/path abstractions rather than provider-specific UI code. Conversation and session bootstrap persistence is under `src/core/bootstrap/ConversationPersistenceStore.ts` and `src/app/conversations/ConversationRepository.ts`; shared plugin state is handled by `src/app/storage/SharedStorageService.ts`. Settings select enabled providers, models, CLI paths, and environment behavior through `src/app/settings/SettingsCoordinator.ts` and `src/core/providers/ProviderSettingsCoordinator.ts`. Agent skills are validated and stored through `src/core/skills/AgentSkillRepository.ts`.

## Collaboration Subsystem
Collab is a substantial lazy application subsystem rooted at `src/app/collab/CollabFeatureService.ts` and exposed by `src/features/collab/sidebar/CollabPanel.ts`. It creates/joins projects, tracks membership and tickets, publishes Git contributions, supports review/acceptance and reconciliation, and provides conflict workflows. Core lifecycle stages are represented by `src/app/collab/project/CollabProjectSetupService.ts`, `src/app/collab/publish/PublishCoordinator.ts`, `src/app/collab/review/CollabReviewService.ts`, and `src/app/collab/reconciliation/ReconciliationCoordinator.ts`.

## Collab Authority, Networking, and Durability
Collab separates local Git/workspace operations from authority and transport. Git runs through `src/app/collab/git/GitRepositoryService.ts`; project authority is persisted with sql.js repositories in `src/app/collab/authority/SqlJsProjectDatabase.ts`. LAN hosting exposes authenticated HTTPS control and Git routes via `src/app/collab/lan/LanHostCoordinator.ts` and `src/app/collab/lan/CollabControlRouter.ts`. Cloud mode uses the self-hosted Claudian Cloud Server through adapters/transports in `src/app/collab/remote-authority/CloudAuthorityAdapter.ts`. Host/authority relocation is explicitly durable and recoverable, centered on `src/app/collab/host-transfer/HostTransferModule.ts` and `src/app/collab/authority-transfer/AuthorityTransferModule.ts`.
